identity.note: these three pre-registrations are written *after* the commit they name, so `dirty` is true here and the difference is exactly these files plus the P0' drivers under work/v03/. They are committed next, and the batch they govern runs from a clean tree, so every manifest written by that batch names a real commit with `dirty: false`. Nothing here is written after its own batch starts.

per_cell_acceptance: manifest identity (provider / model / planner) equals the seat above
run_error bucketed into 429 / quota / other; the first two are environment errors and are not read as an arm effect (SPEC §6 E1)
armed => asked the model > 0 per cell — the count that was 575/0 in the v0.2 arm domain and must flip here

schema_freeze.re_freeze: not done and not permitted this phase (SPEC §12); a product change that moved any of these would have had to stop and ask

call_upper_bound.approval: D2 approved 2,500; the measured bound is 2484 and the approved number is above it
call_upper_bound.how: P5-c's `decision` records re-counted per cell ({"em": 600, "long_horizon": 888}) plus one goal parse per episode ({"em": 96, "long_horizon": 72}) = 1656; x1.5 headroom = 2484. The v0.2 report §8 A1 quotes the same 1,656 and the same formula; it is re-measured here rather than quoted twice.

spec_8_four_cells.checkpoint_strategy: advance cell by cell; write a cell-level summary the moment a cell finishes; a restart resumes only unfinished cells, and a paid cell is never re-run (SPEC §8.3 — v0.2 report §8 F: a repeated id is a second row, not an overwrite)
stop_rules: 3 consecutive requests dying of 429 / quota -> stop the batch, keep the breakpoint, record it (SPEC §8.2)
the upper bound is hit -> stop; 'a little more' is not a rule
a single episode hitting the task table's own budget is a normal termination, not an incident (SPEC §8.2)

unit_price.why: the endpoint is a free tier and no price is configured, so `api_cost_estimate` / `cost_estimate_usd` stay null (SPEC §7.1). Request counts, prompt/completion tokens and per-call latency are reported instead; a number here would be invented.
